inspections.finding: At zoom6 on viewer page 525 (printed תקח / 508), the complete gimel in מוּגת sits above a detached, flat horizontal lower bar with a clear white gap below the gimel foot and no central descending stem or vertical dot pair. It matches same-page gimel patah in גַּם and he/ayin patah in הַפַּחַד, while defeating gimel sheva in וַיִּגְוְעוּ, het qamats in חָרְדוּ, lamed tsere in לֵב, and pe segol in פֶּחָד. Certify U+05B7 after U+05D2.

At zoom6 on viewer page 525, the complete het in תֶּחזה displays five distinct lower nodes: a three-node triangular segol cluster on the left (two upper nodes and one centered lower node) paired with a two-node vertical sheva column on the right. It matches literal he hataf-segol in הֱיוֹת (viewer page 491, printed תעד / 474) and defeats het hataf-patah in הַמַּחֲזֶה (same page, flat left bar plus right vertical pair), alef hataf-qamats in כָּאֳנִיָּה (viewer page 499, printed תפב / 482), plain segol, and plain sheva. Certify U+05B1 after U+05D7.

At zoom6 on viewer page 525, the complete zayin in תֶּחזה sits above a three-node triangular lower contour (two upper nodes separated by a top-center notch converging to a third lower central node). It matches initial tav segol in the same word תֶּחזה, zayin segol in הַמַּחֲזֶה, and pe segol in פֶּחָד on the same page, while defeating patah, qamats, tsere, and sheva. Certify U+05B6 after U+05D6.
